subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

Once upon a time there was a very rich man __which lived with__ his three daughters.
solution:
The correct answer is **'who lived with'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **Simple Past tense**. 
 
• The correct structure would be **Subject + V2 **and the correct form for 'live' would be **'****lived'**.
 
• The pronoun **'who'** is used when referring to a person.
 
 
• Example- She is the one **who** stole the car.
 
 
 
• So the right improvement would be:** 'who lived with'**.
